description: A whole page (list, detail, form, settings, dashboard, sign-in) built from this organisation's components and spacing scale, in the project's framework: the files to create, which component fills each part, and the page's rules (states, layout, accessibility). Call before building a new page or screen; rename the sample data and keep the structure. Without a name, lists the templates.

framework.description: The project's UI framework (from its package.json: @angular/core → angular, vue → vue, svelte → svelte, solid-js → solid, react → react). Defaults to the one set for this connection.

name.description: Template name or what the page is, e.g. "list", "login", "admin index". One of: list, detail, form, settings, dashboard, sign-in

name: get_template
title: Start a page from a template
